0022600151.text: The Cavaliers (3-2) enter their sixth game of the season 1.5 games behind first-place... no, 1.5 games back in second place in the Central and fifth in the East, but they have lost their last game and are 0-2 on the road. The Bucks (1-4) are fourth in the Central, 3.5 games back, 13th in the East, and also coming off a loss. Cleveland is missing Jaylon Tyson (out, ankle sprain) and Meleek Thomas (day-to-day, foot, game-time decision), and the two teams have not met yet this season, though the Cavaliers won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 123-116 win in Milwaukee on March 17, 2026.
